prompt:

Caption timing is a measured signal that a teacher and personal browser agent calibrate together against visible evidence. Visual world: classroom science instruments, oscilloscope calibration, optical bench. Cool bone work surface, deep navy/graphite instrument housings, restrained oscilloscope green for verified signal, amber for attention, slate secondary readings. Etched grid, anodized aluminum edges, optical glass over the video, finely ruled measurement marks. Workhorse modern UI typography; large timecodes may use a technical numeric face but transcript prose stays highly readable. Dense, precise, calm, daylight-lab rather than dark sci-fi. Constraints: show a complete coherent desktop application first viewport; all core regions visible; familiar controls; caption text never rendered in instrument digits; no chat panel, no speech bubbles, no gavel, no courtroom imagery, no neon cyberpunk, no generic AI dashboard, no marketing hero, no login, no device frame, no watermark.
